subject.title: fix(secrets): collect persona-level TTS provider SecretRefs

question: After the control-flow defect and proof gap are fixed, should persona TTS SecretRef activation land under the current fail-closed startup contract before the optional-TTS policy in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101204 is resolved?
rationale: This correctness fix makes previously ignored persona credentials participate in startup activation, which can expose existing missing values as Gateway startup failures; code review cannot choose that release sequencing policy.

options.title: Land under current contract
options.body: Merge the corrected and proven collector fix under the existing fail-closed SecretRef contract, leaving optional TTS degradation to its separate canonical issue.

options.title: Sequence after fail-open policy
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers decide and land the optional-TTS startup behavior so activating persona refs cannot introduce a new whole-Gateway failure mode.

recommendation.title: Land under current contract
recommendation.body: Merge the corrected and proven collector fix under the existing fail-closed SecretRef contract, leaving optional TTS degradation to its separate canonical issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The release choice concerns the SecretRef runtime and startup activation contract introduced in their merged feature work.
